meta.label: Sunrise Example
meta.description: Example theme demonstrating CSS overrides and a small theme.js enhancement.

show-dashboard-title.label: Show dashboard title
show-dashboard-title.description: Show the portal title in the page header.

show-section-title.label: Show section title
show-section-title.description: Show the current section name in the page header.

show-section-thumbnails.label: Show section thumbnails in header
show-section-thumbnails.description: Show or hide section thumbnails in the header navigation.

cards-per-row-desktop.label: Cards per row on desktop
cards-per-row-desktop.description: Number of cards shown per row on desktop screens. Use 0 to fit as many cards as possible.

cards-per-row-tablet.label: Cards per row on tablet
cards-per-row-tablet.description: Number of cards shown per row on tablet screens. Use 0 to fit as many cards as possible.

cards-per-row-mobile.label: Cards per row on mobile
cards-per-row-mobile.description: Number of cards shown per row on mobile screens. Use 0 to fit as many cards as possible.

accent-color.label: Accent color
accent-color.description: Primary accent used for active navigation, drawer headings and badges.
